{{Quote|Well that's my cue! Best to father and send my love to Lieda.|Jobin, in a letter to Mon Mothma|<ref name="Ent" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' and the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Ent" /> [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrilan]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]]<ref name="NGEC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] of the [[Mothma family/Legends|Mothma family]] [[Reproduction/Legends|had]] a Human son named [[Jobin]]. Jobin became a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="Ent" /> an organization Mothma had founded.<ref name="NGEC" /> While stationed on<ref name="Ent" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]<ref name="Ent" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">[[Jobin]]'s recording in "[[Entrenched]]" concludes with the beginning of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> Jobin recorded a message for Mothma, which, after hearing about encroaching [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|walkers]], he concluded by asking her to send his best wishes to his [[Parent/Legends|father]] and love to<ref name="Ent" /> [[Lieda Mothma]], his sister.<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|II|169|Jobin, Corporal}}</ref> Subsequently, Jobin was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial forces]] in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], with his message not reaching his mother until leadup to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Ent" /> in [[4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC Endor">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|<nowiki />''Star Wars: Visionaries'' has revealed that Lieda is not an only child. She has a brother, Corporal Jobin, who served at the Battle of Hoth. Again, no indication of surname or father is present.|Pablo Hidalgo, responding to a fan question about Lieda Mothma|<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|82|Ask Lobot|Ask the Master}}</ref>}}
Jobin's father was mentioned in "[[Entrenched]]," a short comic story written by [[Alex Jaeger]] and [[M. Zachary Sherman]]. The comic was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] comic anthology ''[[Star Wars: Visionaries]]'',<ref name="Ent" /> released on [[April 2]], [[2005]].<ref name="Visionaries date">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/comics/news20050315.html|text=Inside ''Star Wars: Visionaries''}}</ref> In the [[Ask Lobot|Ask the Master]] section of the [[Star Wars Insider 82|82nd issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="Insider" /> which began shipping to subscribers on [[May 17]], 2005,<ref name="Insider date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050506.html|text=The Dark Side Shines in ''Star Wars Insider'' #82}}</ref> author [[Pablo Hidalgo]] responded to a fan query about Mon Mothma's daughter Lieda and the identity of her father. Hidalgo acknowledged Jobin in his response and stated that "Entrenched" did not give any indication about the identity of either child's father.<ref name="Insider" />

The [[canon]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' introduced [[Mon Mothma]]'s [[Marriage|husband]] and [[Leida Mothma]]'s [[Parent|father]], [[Perrin Fertha]], in the [[Andor Season 1|first season's]] fourth episode titled "[[Aldhani (episode)|Aldhani]],"<ref name="Andor">{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}}</ref> which premiered on [[September 28]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref> As Jobin's father was not established to be either Mon Mothma's husband or Lieda's father, this article does not assume that the character is a counterpart to Fertha.
